title: Unity gives Codex first-party skills for current engine workflows
friendlyTitle: Unity gives Codex official, up-to-date instructions
summary: Unity’s official Codex plugin launches with 31 skills covering project setup, UI, graphics, audio, physics, multiplayer, purchases and localisation. Unity engineers maintain the guidance for Unity 6 and later, and the plugin can inspect projects, use current APIs and verify results.
friendlySummary: Unity has released a Codex plugin with 31 skills written by its own engineering teams. It covers common game-development jobs and works with Unity 6 or newer.
whyItMatters: First-party skills can reduce a coding agent’s dependence on stale forum posts and tutorials, a common source of plausible but broken code. The approach also gives teams a useful pattern: connect agents to versioned instructions owned by the people responsible for the underlying platform.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Coding agents often learn from old tutorials. Official instructions can reduce mistakes caused by outdated APIs and workflows.
